layers.name: Light oak solid wood table
layers.description: A solid wood table with distinct oak grain, including a flat tabletop, table edge and right-side table leg, serving as the furniture that holds the items on its surface. Exclude upper items placed on the table such as the mug and notebook during extraction.

layers.name: White ceramic mug
layers.description: A plain white empty ceramic mug with a handle, placed on the table. Exclude unrelated surrounding elements such as the table surface and notebook during extraction.

layers.name: Grey hardcover notebook
layers.description: A closed hardcover notebook with a grey fabric cover, with white pages visible along the side, placed alone on the table. Exclude unrelated surrounding elements such as the table surface and mug during extraction.
